claim.quote: the operation of 8 units with similar features shows, on average, a baseline energy resolution of $26\pm7$ eV.

key_value.note: Average baseline energy resolution of 8 units of the 64-dice prototype.

name: BULLKID: Monolithic array of particle absorbers sensed by Kinetic Inductance Detectors
notes: Technology milestone; the BULLKID prototype is the detector concept of BULLKID-DM, run in a surface laboratory.

summary.plain: The first BULLKID prototype was a silicon wafer carved into 64 little blocks, each sensed by a superconducting resonator. Eight of them reached a baseline energy resolution of about 26 electronvolts.
summary.technical: BULLKID prototype: 64 dices of 5.4x5.4x5 mm^3 carved in a 3 inch, 5 mm thick silicon wafer with a 0.5 mm common disk hosting a 60 nm patterned aluminium KID layer; 8 units with similar features give on average 26 +- 7 eV baseline resolution.

title: BULLKID: Monolithic array of particle absorbers sensed by Kinetic Inductance Detectors
why_it_matters: The paper says this makes the detector suitable for low-energy processes such as direct interactions of dark matter and CEvNS.
